name: Plurality (first past the post)
summary: Each voter supports one candidate. The largest total wins, even when that total is below half.
steps: Count each ballot for its chosen candidate, or its first ranked candidate.
Return every candidate sharing the largest total.
variant: Single winner plurality; ranking input is a convenience for choosing its first entry.
tieNotes: Final equal best candidates are returned together. When a stage needs a single choice, the earlier candidate in the submitted candidates array has priority; this is part of the simulation, not a claim about every implementation.
complexity: O(b + m) tally work for b ballot groups and m candidates.
limits: See the API guide for shared input limits.
